title: They Called Him a Rent-a-Cop
description: Tech heiress Victoria Vance is dragged into a deadly corporate war after her father's death, kidnapped and left for dead — until Caleb, a legendary assassin trying to retire, saves her. What starts as survival becomes an impossible, dangerous love. A roughly 114-minute YouTube upload with over 2.4 million views since its June 2026 release.
